title: A late line priced by a newer run of the month, then the older re-run accepted
assertion: Refused as `superseded`, in the worker and through the screens. The late line keeps its pricing in effect and the newer run stays in effect. The re-run's page says a newer run of these service dates is in effect, links to it and offers no Accept button. When that run was priced after the re-run and would price nothing differently now, the page says there is nothing more to accept and offers no re-run; otherwise it offers the re-run of that run
noFileReason: No file of its own: SYNTHETIC 835s the pricing world already loads.
